inputs.name: interfaces
inputs.description: Addresses unbound listens on, port 53. "0.0.0.0" and "::" mean every address.

inputs.name: access_control
inputs.description: Who may query, as a list of { cidr, action }, such as { cidr = "192.168.1.0/24", action = "allow" }. Networks not listed are refused. The most specific match wins.

inputs.name: forwarders
inputs.description: Upstream resolvers to send every query to, in unbound's forward-addr form, such as "9.9.9.9#dns.quad9.net". When empty, unbound resolves from the root servers itself.

inputs.name: forward_tls
inputs.description: Send queries to forwarders over DNS over TLS, on port 853 unless a forwarder gives its own. Give each forwarder a #name to check its certificate against.

inputs.name: local_zones
inputs.description: Zones unbound answers itself, by name, with their type, such as { "home.arpa." = "static" }. A static zone answers from local_data and says any other name in it doesn't exist.

inputs.name: local_data
inputs.description: Records unbound answers with, in zone file form, such as ["nas.home.arpa. A 192.168.1.10"].

inputs.name: msg_cache_size
inputs.description: Memory for cached answers, such as "16m" or "256m".

inputs.name: rrset_cache_size
inputs.description: Memory for cached records. Unbound suggests twice msg_cache_size.

inputs.name: use_as_system_resolver
inputs.description: Point the host's own lookups at unbound on 127.0.0.1, through systemd-resolved where it runs, and keep NetworkManager from changing that.
